UserAccountProfile.title: User Account Profile
UserAccountProfile.description: Authenticated user account metadata and synced profile avatar shared across linked devices.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version identifier for forward-compatible sync deserialization.

displayName.description: User display name from Google Sign-In.

email.description: User email address from Google Sign-In.

photoUrl.description: Optional remote profile photo URL from Google Sign-In.

avatarBase64.description: Optional compressed JPEG thumbnail in Base64 synced across connected devices, or empty string when cleared.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when user profile was first created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

SyncedDevice.title: Synced Device
SyncedDevice.description: Individual Android device linked under the user's account for optional cross-device lock sync.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version identifier for linked device records.

androidVersion.description: Android API level reported by this linked device.

appVersion.description: App version string reported by this linked device.

syncEnabled.description: Whether this device receives and participates in synced lock commands.

lastSeenAt.description: Server timestamp when this device last synced (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when device was registered (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when device record was updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

SyncedLockCommand.title: Synced Lock Command
SyncedLockCommand.description: Cross-device focus lock trigger broadcast to linked devices with sync enabled.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version identifier for lock command records.

commandId.description: Unique UUID string for deduplicating lock triggers.

originDeviceId.description: Device installation ID that issued the lock trigger.

originDeviceName.description: Display name of the device that issued the lock trigger.

freeUseDurationMinutes.description: Delay window in minutes before lock enforcement activates (0 for instant/scheduled).

lockDurationMinutes.description: Total focus lock duration in minutes.

issuedAtWallMs.description: Origin wall-clock epoch milliseconds when lock trigger was created.

intendedStartWallMs.description: Intended wall-clock start time in epoch milliseconds.

freeUseDeadlineWallMs.description: Target epoch milliseconds when delayed free-use ends (0 when not delayed).

lockExpirationWallMs.description: Target epoch milliseconds when lock enforcement ends.

scheduleId.description: Optional synced schedule identifier when mode is SCHEDULED.

occurrenceId.description: Deterministic occurrence key preventing duplicate scheduled lock execution across devices.

strictMode.description: Whether Strict Mode (no recovery unlock) is active for this session.

showFlipClockShortcut.description: Whether the Flip Clock shortcut is shown on the lock screen dock.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when command doc was first created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest command broadcast (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

SyncedDelayedPreset.title: Synced Delayed Preset
SyncedDelayedPreset.description: User-created Delayed Lock preset synced across signed-in devices.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version identifier for preset documents.

originDeviceId.description: Device installation ID that created or updated this preset.

updatedAtWallMs.description: Wall-clock timestamp in milliseconds for deterministic last-write merge.

deleted.description: Tombstone flag marking deletion across linked devices.

SyncedSchedule.title: Synced Schedule
SyncedSchedule.description: Schedule rules synced across signed-in devices when explicitly opted in, excluding per-device allowlists.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version identifier for schedule documents.

oneTimeDateEpochDay.description: Epoch day for one-time schedules, or -1 for recurring schedules.

syncAcrossDevices.description: Whether schedule is configured to sync across linked devices.

strictMode.description: Whether Strict Mode (no recovery exit) is enabled on this schedule.

allowSelectedApps.description: Whether selected allowlisted apps remain accessible during this schedule.

showFlipClockShortcut.description: Whether Flip Clock shortcut is shown during this schedule.

originDeviceId.description: Device installation ID that saved this schedule.

updatedAtWallMs.description: Wall-clock timestamp in milliseconds for deterministic merge.

SyncedLockProfileSettings.title: Synced Lock Profile Settings
SyncedLockProfileSettings.description: Per-lock-mode profile defaults (Strict Mode, Allow Selected Apps, Flip Clock shortcut, allowed packages) synced across signed-in devices.

SyncedFlipClockSettings.title: Synced Flip Clock Settings
SyncedFlipClockSettings.description: Flip Clock display preferences synced across linked devices (never stores local hardware brightness).

SyncedFlipTimerPreset.title: Synced Flip Timer Preset
SyncedFlipTimerPreset.description: Flip Clock countdown preset (built-in or custom) synced across linked devices with LWW tombstones.

/users/{userId}.description: Account owner profile document containing display info and synced thumbnail avatar.

/users/{userId}/devices/{deviceId}.description: Connected Android devices registered under the owner's Google account.

/users/{userId}/lock_commands/{commandId.description: Versioned cross-device lock commands collection with commandId and occurrenceId deduplication.

/users/{userId}/presets/{presetId}.description: User-created Delayed Lock presets synced across linked devices.

/users/{userId}/schedules/{scheduleId}.description: Schedules explicitly opted into All Linked Devices sync.

/users/{userId}/lock_profiles/{profileMo.description: Per-mode lock profile defaults (INSTANT, DELAYED, SCHEDULED) synced across linked devices.

/users/{userId}/flip_timer_presets/{pres.description: Flip Clock timer presets (up to 15 active) synced with tombstone LWW resolution.
